# Family Dinner Plan for Mexico City on 2026-07-24

A good fit is a **casual Mexican restaurant with strong vegetarian options, no shellfish on the menu or easy shellfish avoidance, and a reservation window around 19:00–20:00**. Since live restaurant data isn’t available here, the most useful next step is a comparison framework you can apply to any short list.

## Best Dining Criteria for Your Group

| Criterion | What to look for | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Cuisine fit | Mexican menu with tacos, enchiladas, pozole, mole, antojitos | Keeps the meal aligned with your preference |
| Vegetarian coverage | At least 3–5 vegetarian mains, not just sides | Makes ordering easy for the vegetarian guest |
| Shellfish control | Clear separation from shrimp/crab dishes; staff can confirm prep | Reduces allergy/cross-contact risk |
| Budget | Estimated total under **1,500 MXN** for 4 people | Keeps the outing within your target |
| Timing | Reservation-friendly seating between **18:30 and 21:00** | Helps avoid long waits with family |
| Family comfort | Indoor seating, moderate noise, kid-friendly pacing | Improves the overall dinner experience |

## Option Comparison Framework

| Option Type | Best For | Typical Spend for 4 | Vegetarian Friendliness | Reservation Ease | Risk to Watch |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Casual taquería with sit-down tables | Fast, affordable, flexible | 700–1,200 MXN | Medium to high | Medium | Limited seated comfort |
| Mid-range Mexican cantina | Better service and broader menu | 1,000–1,500 MXN | High | High | Some dishes may be shellfish-heavy |
| Modern Mexican bistro | Polished experience, good menu labeling | 1,200–1,500 MXN | High | High | Portions can be smaller |
| Neighborhood fonda | Best value and home-style food | 600–1,000 MXN | Medium | Medium | Fewer reservation options |

## Sample Booking Checklist

- Confirm the restaurant can seat **4 people** between **18:30 and 21:00**
- Ask whether they can **accommodate one vegetarian guest**
- Ask if the kitchen can **avoid shellfish and cross-contact**
- Check whether they have **guacamole, quesadillas, enfrijoladas, nopales, huitlacoche, mushroom tacos, or vegetarian enchiladas**
- Ask for an **estimated total for 4** with drinks and tax
- Confirm whether a **reservation is needed** or if walk-in seating is realistic
- Mention any preference for **quiet seating** or **indoor tables**
- Save the booking under a name and note the **exact party size and time**

## Booking Message You Can Send

Hola, quisiera reservar para **4 personas** el **24 de julio de 2026** entre **18:30 y 21:00**.
Tenemos **1 persona vegetariana** y queremos evitar **mariscos y contacto cruzado con mariscos**.
¿Tienen disponibilidad y un estimado de costo para una cena dentro de **1,500 MXN**?

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Reservation Platforms] https://www.opentable.com.mx/
Action: [Button: Mexican Menu Ideas] https://www.google.com/search?q=Mexican+vegetarian+dishes+no+shellfish

## Sources

- OpenTable Mexico: https://www.opentable.com.mx/
- Google Maps restaurant search: https://www.google.com/maps
- Mexican cuisine reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexican_cuisine
